liturgicalDay.feastOrSaint: Tuesday of the twenty-second week of Ordinary Time

verseOfDay.text: And he went down into Capharnaum, a city of Galilee, and there he taught them on the sabbath days.

prayer.title: The Glory Be
prayer.text:
Glory be to the Father,
and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be,
world without end.
Amen.
prayer.note: The shortest way to give God the last word on a day.

consider.question: What is purgatory?
consider.answer: The final purification of those who die in God's friendship but are not yet wholly free of the effects of sin. Everyone in purgatory is saved — this is not a second chance and not a lesser hell. It is why the Church prays for the dead, and why that prayer is worth doing.
